case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised cleanliness, central location, comfortable beds and bright rooms, along with friendly staff, accessible late check-in, a well-equipped shared kitchen and generally good breakfast offerings. Reported negatives included traffic noise in some rooms, limited room/storage space and places to dry towels/swimsuits, occasional limited breakfast fruit/options, a non-adjustable shower height for one guest, one guest noting no visible parking and one mentioning a small bed.
